items.title: 25.3.2 The Loss of Energy between Trophic Levels (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of energy loss between trophic levels (PDF 234-235).

blocks.text: Ecosystem mein aam taur par teen ya chaar trophic levels hote hain. Producers apne par girne wali suraj ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 1-2% organic maadde ki kimiyai tawanai mein badalte hain, aur har level ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 10% agle tak jata hai; baqi har level par zaya hoti hai, is liye mukhtalif levels ke jandaron se guzarne ke baad bohat kam kaam ki tawanai bachti hai.

blocks.alt: Oval shakal ka consumer: teer khaya hua khana andar lata; teer bahar jate: faeces (jazb nahi hua), respiration (garmi ban kar zaya) aur barhotri (naya jismani tissue, agle level ke liye dastiyab).
blocks.caption: Consumer ki khoraak ki tawanai kahan jati hai (Figure 25.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Consumer ki khayi hui saari tawanai agle trophic level tak nahi pohanchti. Kuch kabhi jazb nahi hoti aur faeces mein nikal jati, zyada tar respiration mein use ho kar garmi ban kar zaya hoti, aur sirf woh hissa jo naye jismani tissue (barhotri) mein lagta hai consumer ke khaye jane par aage jata hai. Isi liye aik level se agle tak sirf taqreeban 10% tawanai jati, aur chhoti food chains lambi chains se zyada tawanai bachati hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: chhoti chains mo'assar
blocks.text: Kam trophic levels wali chhoti food chains lambi chains se zyada mo'assar hain kyunke har muntaqili par tawanai garmi ban kar zaya hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar producers 50,000 kcal fix karein to secondary consumers tak taqreeban kitni pohanchegi?

items: Producers dhoop ka 1-2% jama karte; har agle level tak taqreeban 10%.
10,000 se 1,000 se 100 se 10 kcal; chhoti chains kam tawanai zaya karti.
